subject: Sandbox supplier — temporary fastpass invoice route for pilot
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@ventureresearch.com>
To: markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding — sandbox account and invoice route request

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking the time on the call yesterday. We're excited to spin up the sandbox trial and start ingesting a subset of telemetry into your hosted environment. A couple of asks from our finance/procurement side so we can get invoices processed quickly:

- VentureResearch is a small R&D outfit; our procurement team prefers invoice-only billing for short technical pilots to avoid a full PO process. Can Redwood accommodate a 60-day invoice-only arrangement for the initial sandbox (estimate <$5k in spend)?
- If yes, what intake evidence do you need (forms, W-9, insurance)?
- We'll also need a simple mutual action plan so our legal can sign off — DocuSign is preferred.

I've attached our supplier intake form to speed things up (supplier_intake_form.pdf). Please loop in procurement if you want to run this through your exception ladder.

Appreciate it — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Lina Gomez
Head of Platform Partnerships
VentureResearch

Attachment: supplier_intake_form.pdf (application/pdf)
From: markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@ventureresearch.com>
Cc: priy a_natarajan@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — sandbox account and invoice route request

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear notes and for sharing the intake form. Quick reply while I sync with Procurement and Legal: 

Short answer: we can often offer a short-term invoice-only path for sandbox pilots under our "Fastpass" pilot program, subject to a few conditional items. To set expectations up front, the typical conditions are: 

- Max spend cap for the invoice-only pilot: $5,000 USD total across the pilot period.
- Pilot duration for Fastpass: up to 60 days (can extend subject to renewal and evidence).
- Required intake docs: completed supplier intake form (you've attached), W-9 (or local tax form), and proof of insurance if services include access to customer-managed endpoints (your attached insurance PDF looks fine at a glance).
- We need a signed mutual action summary (not a full contract) via DocuSign that lists trial dates and acceptance criteria.

Marissa, Priya — looping you both in. Marissa: could you confirm whether Legal needs any standard clause for the 60-day Fastpass? Priya: can Procurement provisionally approve invoice-only up to $5k so we can start work next week, and advise on any PO-trigger thresholds we should watch for?

Lina — if that all looks ok I can draft the mutual action summary and send a DocuSign link. I'll include a clear rollback path to a PO-mandated workflow if spend or data-sensitivity changes.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: draft_fastpass_checklist.txt (text/plain)
From: priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com
To: markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@ventureresearch.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Jul 2028 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — sandbox account and invoice route request

Thanks for the ping, Markus. Procurement position: we can approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding for VentureResearch under the following conditions (documenting for audit):

1) Financial controls
- Pilot cap: $5,000 total. Any single invoice over $2,500 requires sign-off from Procurement lead.
- Payment terms: Net 30.
2) Evidence required before activation
- Completed supplier_intake_form.pdf (received).
- Signed W-9 or export-equivalent (Ventureresearch to provide).
- Certificate of insurance showing general liability at minimum $1M (we received ventureresearch_insurance.pdf but need policy number).
3) Operational controls
- Trial account will be flagged as "Fastpass — Temporary Invoice" in our billing system and will be reviewed at day 30 for consumption trends.
- If usage looks like it will exceed $5k or involves regulated data, Procurement can pause new consumption until a PO is in place.
4) Timebox
- Approval window: 60 days from activation date. Extensions must be requested via procurement@redwoodinference.com and approved by Procurement manager.

Marissa — Legal follow-up: please confirm whether we need a simple addendum (1 paragraph) to the MSA or if the mutual action summary Markus drafts is sufficient for Legal to cover the trial.

Markus/Lina — once we have the W-9 and the policy number for insurance, Procurement will issue an approval memo that Lina can attach to your invoice submission. I'll draft that memo and share it here.

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Sr. Manager, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: procurement_fastpass_template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@ventureresearch.com>
To: markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: priy a_natarajan@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — sandbox account and invoice route request

Hi Markus/Priya/Marissa — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and for documenting the conditions.

Summary from our side:
- We'll send W-9 and the insurer's policy number later today (we've confirmed the certificate).
- 60-day pilot, estimate $3–4k total. Net 30 payment terms are fine.
- Please send the mutual action summary for e-signature; DocuSign link works.

Markus — can you send the DocuSign link and the activation checklist when you have a moment? Once signed we'll share the intake attachments with our AP team so invoices route properly.

Looking forward to getting the sandbox live — Lina
